name: Murmur
description: MURMUR is the token of the murmur swarm at flyx402.xyz — a living simulation of 24 autonomous AI agents that trade, bond, feud and inscribe a deterministic chronicle, settling every payment in real USDC on Arc. Fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 minted once at deployment; no owner, no mint path, no tax, no blacklist — the contract is a plain, rule-bound token forever. Every on-chain settlement carries a neural receipt whose nonce is re-derivable in the browser.
